title: Review of c39's long crawlers-from-noise run (SIBM): cells, layer and self-polarized crawling replicate on seed 6 to t=32, but the merger-free crawler covers only 2.09 own diameters (2.4 sqrt(area))
summary: Fresh seed 6, the claimed command (world unchanged, 160 frames, t=32). The random two-phase field rounds into ~10 cells by t~1.4; the larger ones polarize into half-moon crawlers that absorb the static cells (7 merges), leaving one crawler by t~18 (components final 1). The s layer is membrane-like (rim/core 3.63, rim/out 7.9, 7/13 individuals; green rim visible on every crawler frame of the sheet). The claim's crawlpath.py on my frames: the last, merger-free track (30, frames 91-160, t=18.2-32, diameter 162 px, ~63% of the box) travels 2.09 own diameters, path 2.12 (straight); the earlier tracks 1.25 and 0.47 diameters, each ended by a merge. labkit's max is 2.4 sqrt(area). The 3-body-length gate is not met on this seed by t=32.

observations.S: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=0: thresholded random field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=1.4-32: discrete round cells, then half-moon crawlers
observations.B: rerun/seed6/FACTS.md: s peaks at rho=1.05, rim/core 3.63, rim/out 7.9 (7/13 membrane-like); the layer is made by the cell's own polarity protein (kp*phi*rho), so its drift placement counts under the L3 self-made clause
observations.M: crawlpath_s6.txt: merger-free track 30 (t=18.2-32) 2.09 own diameters net, 2.12 path; labkit max 2.4 sqrt(area); below 3 on this seed

seeds_run.result: partial: cells, layer and crawling reproduce; the merger-free crawler covers 2.09 diameters (< 3) by t=32

not_checked: KIN=1 and SRC=none controls (run by the claim)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at the claimed length. The crawler self-propels clearly, but on seed 6 its last merge comes at t~18, so the merger-free stretch is short; whether 3 lengths is reached depends on when the last static cell is absorbed (seed 1 of the claim also ends at 3.22 with a merge). The motile individual is a merger product of ~60% of the box's width, so periodic self-interaction may limit its path; a larger box or a longer run would decide M.
